exposure: Presence of obstetric nurses in an Antepartum, Intrapartum, Postpartum (AIP) unit
outcome: Quality of care during labor and childbirth
cohort: 701 childbirths at an AIP unit at a teaching hospital in the capital of the Brazilian state of Mato Grosso between 2014 and 2016.
finding: The inclusion of obstetric nurses in an AIP unit was associated with improved quality of care during labour and childbirth, a reduction in interventions, and good perinatal results.
